summary: Well-engineered PowerShell solution with strong structure. Workflow YAML is clean and properly pinned (checkout@v4); scripts use [CmdletBinding()], ErrorActionPreference='Stop', explicit parameter validation. Module pattern separates policy engine (pure, testable) from CLI wrapper and CI orchestration. Test harness comprehensively validates act integration with explicit expected-value assertions. Minor gaps: missing Set-StrictMode for maximum rigor; parameter forwarding in ci/run-cleanup.ps1 (lines 26–30) is somewhat verbose; artifact validation loop could use more inline explanation; no explicit empty-collection testing. Strong TDD discipline throughout. Would ship.
